title: Geometry-Consistent Bayesian Filtering under Structural Model Uncertainty: A Geometric Projection Particle Filter
summary: Nonlinear state estimation under structural model uncertainty remains a fundamental challenge in autonomous Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) systems. Conventional Bayesian filtering separates state propagation from measurement correction, allowing model mismatch to accumulate during propagation, resulting in proposal--likelihood inconsistency, particle degeneracy, and degraded estimation accuracy.
